text: Sonqorabad (Persian: سنقرآباد) is a village and the capital of Chahardangeh Rural District in the Central District. The previous capital of the rural district was the village of Chahar Dangeh, which is now the city of Chaharbagh. During the 2006 National Census, the village had a population of 1,376 people living in 337 households, at that time located in the Ramjin Rural District of the Chaharbagh District in Savojbolagh County, Tehran province. The 2016 census recorded the population as 1,777 people in 564 households, occurring when the county had been transferred from Tehran province to the newly established Alborz province. In 2020, the district was separated from the county to form Chaharbagh County, and the Central District was created. As part of this reorganization, the rural district was transferred to the new Ramjin District, and Sonqorabad was moved to Chahardangeh Rural District within the Central District.
